name: The Frozen Ascent & Beacon Ridge
act: Act III: The Climb That Is Not On Any Plan
description: High crystalline steps leading into the cloud layer. Factor Vane has seeded provisional Entropy Beacons that turn ambient air into zero-entropy vacuum and coat the stairs in frictionless black ice. Smashing beacons allows Criticizing and Tombstoning them in the Cartographers' Ledger.

cast.name: Factor Vane of House Kestrel
cast.description: Triggering entropy beacons to freeze the path solid while his bearers ascend into the sky cathedral.

cast.name: Surveyor-Senior Vellum
cast.description: Striking permanent tombstones into the ledger to ensure shattered beacons cannot re-synthesize.

primitives.name: House Kestrel Cryo-Entropy Beacon
primitives.description: Monolithic obsidian resonator projecting absolute zero entropy. Must be physically smashed and criticized in the ledger to collapse the vacuum zone.

primitives.name: Wished Granite Chasm Bridge
primitives.description: Heart-granite span summoned by Orom's literal forge, spanning the gap where stairs unloaded.
